questions.question_english: 39. Which state in India shares land borders with the maximum number of other Indian states?
questions.explanation_english: Uttar Pradesh occupies a central geographic location in northern India and shares administrative land borders with the maximum number of neighboring Indian states. It borders eight states—Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar—along with the National Capital Territory of Delhi. questions.question_english: 98. Which region in Telangana is renowned for its rich limestone reserves that support a dense concentration of cement industries?

The region forms a vital industrial hub supplying bulk cement to various markets.

questions.question_english: 23. The local storms that occur in West Bengal towards the end of summer, bringing heavy rain and thunderstorms beneficial for rice and jute cultivation, are locally known as:

The Brahmaputra River originates from the
Chemayungdung glacier near Lake Manasarovar

questions.question_english: 21. Which region in India receives the highest rainfall during the North-East (retreating) Monsoon season in October and November?

questions.question_english: 56. Which of the following is the largest landlocked river in India that originates in the Aravalli range and terminates in the Rann of Kutch?
questions.explanation_english: The Luni River is the largest inland drainage river system in the arid region of western Rajasthan. Originating in the Pushkar valley of the Aravalli Range near Ajmer, it flows southwestward across the Thar Desert over a distance of over four hundred kilometers. Due to high evaporation and dry sandy soil, the river terminates in the marshy saline flats of the Rann of Kutch.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। लूनी नदी पश्चिमी राजस्थान के शुष्क क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ा अंतर्देशीय जल निकासी नदी प्रणाली है। यह अरावली श्रृंखला के पुष्कर घाटी से निकलती है और थार रेगिस्तान के पार चार सौ किलोमीटर से अधिक की दूरी तय करती है। उच्च वाष्पीकरण और सूखी बालूदार मिट्टी के कारण, यह कच्छ के रण के दलदली खारे मैदानों में समाप्त होती है।
